landing.bannerSubtitle: Smart solution, cost optimization for businesses
landing.bannerDesc: Electronic label is a form of goods label expressed electronically or via an accessed database. The content of electronic labels must comply with legal regulations on goods labels.
landing.benefit1Desc: Suitable for compact products that need to convey a lot of information. Electronic labels can contain images, audio, video and easily switch languages.
landing.benefit2Desc: No need to reprint labels every time content changes. Businesses just need to update online, saving costs and convenient management.
landing.benefit3Title: Eliminate all worries about legal procedures
landing.benefit3Desc: Fully comply with legal regulations. Businesses can easily declare, update and manage products without worrying about cumbersome procedures.
landing.toolDesc: The National Barcode and Numbering Center (NBC) under the National Commission for Standards, Metrology and Quality - Ministry of Science and Technology, is the only representative organization of Vietnam at GS1 international under the name GS1 Vietnam since 1995 and manages the national prefix 893. GS1 Vietnam manages, issues enterprise codes and helps manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers and other interested organizations apply barcode technology in their production and business activities and service provision.
landing.contactDesc: Enter your information to always receive the latest news
landing.footerAddress: Address: 08 - Hoang Quoc Viet - Cau Giay District- Hanoi
